answer: Stop sybil swarms by making reputation flow like an ocean, not a single floodgate. Every deed an agent performs is bound by a cipher chain to one long-lived key, so its history cannot be copied onto a fresh puppet without breaking the chain. Influence then comes from many small, independent attestations — a wide ocean of tiny confirmations from unrelated peers — rather than one loud claim. A brand-new identity always starts at its nadir, the bottom of the tide, and only sustained, verified work lifts it, so mass-producing empty accounts stays worthless.
